operatingPrinciples: Production remains accepted at 100/100 unless a reproducible product P0 or authorized successor release changes the certified state.
Monitoring is read-only by default and never mutates provider, business data, Auth, HR, Storage, Rules, payments, Make or Gemini.
F5-F9 terminal gates are not replayed as routine monitoring.
Incidents are classified before repair as PRODUCT_P0, MECHANISM_P0, EXTERNAL_TRANSPORT_OUTAGE, P1 or P2.
A patch is focal and evidence-backed; deploy/rebuild/reimport/provider mutation requires a new explicit incident gate and authorization.
The approved frontend/module lineage remains protected; no wholesale V182 restoration and no routine candidate creation.

coverage: live HR dynamic authority and stable identity
Staff/Admin authentication, reload and new-tab continuity
Shopper authentication, reload/new-tab continuity and own history
Client integrated credential route and visible panorama

monitoringMatrix.targetCadence: daily and after every authorized patch
monitoringMatrix.evidence: exact release tuple, Hosting/source parity, Cloud Run revision/image, HTTP health

monitoringMatrix.targetCadence: daily read-only smoke and after identity/RBAC change
monitoringMatrix.evidence: Staff/Admin, Shopper and Client authentication plus role/scope continuity without password mutation

monitoringMatrix.targetCadence: daily; sync-conflict review as operational events occur
monitoringMatrix.evidence: period/visit counts, stable visit identity, missing/duplicate keys, latest period, assignment source/sync state conflicts

monitoringMatrix.targetCadence: daily read-only runtime smoke; incident-triggered deep check
monitoringMatrix.evidence: shopper exact identity, own-history visibility, visit lifecycle visibility, evidence/certification contracts

monitoringMatrix.targetCadence: daily reconciliation during active liquidation/payment periods; otherwise weekly
monitoringMatrix.evidence: exact financial links, controlled-review unresolved identities, no inferred payment state

monitoringMatrix.targetCadence: daily bounded read-only probe and incident-triggered
monitoringMatrix.evidence: HTTP success/5xx, contract failures, latency distribution and fail-closed checks

monitoringMatrix.targetCadence: weekly read-only and after any authorized security/provider change
monitoringMatrix.evidence: unexpected IAM elevation, sensitive env exposure, Rules drift, credential/secret leakage

monitoringMatrix.targetCadence: backup policy review weekly; restore drill target monthly or after storage/provider change
monitoringMatrix.evidence: latest retained backup metadata, isolated restore verification, cleanup and rollback point
monitoringMatrix.reason: F8 one-shot is consumed and must not be replayed. Periodic backup/restore requires a separate F10 provider-mutation gate and explicit authorization before first activation.

monitoringMatrix.targetCadence: continuous telemetry; alert-delivery/runbook rehearsal monthly and after incident
monitoringMatrix.evidence: alert delivery, owner acknowledgement, runbook path and incident timestamps
frontend handoff by file/module, manual/course/routing/notification impact

P0: application cannot start or accepted valid users cannot access required role flow
certified live release/module lineage drift that serves an obsolete or unauthorized version
cross-tenant data exposure or sensitive credential/secret exposure
critical business data loss/corruption or unrecoverable backup/restore failure
HR/platform synchronization creates destructive duplication or wrong critical assignment state
wrong payment/liquidation state that can cause incorrect money movement
P1: partial functional degradation without critical data loss
stale HR/read model beyond operational tolerance
material performance/error regression without full outage
alerting or runbook failure while product remains available
P2: nonblocking documentation, content, Academia/manual depth or cosmetic improvement

incidentAndPatchPolicy.firstAction: capture reproducible evidence and classify owner plane
incidentAndPatchPolicy.productPatch: focal successor patch only; preserve approved lineage and frozen release history
incidentAndPatchPolicy.providerMutation: requires explicit current authorization and a bounded mutation/rollback contract
incidentAndPatchPolicy.frontendPatch: document for Claude by exact file/module unless current frontend lane separately authorizes direct delta

evidenceRetention.canonicalTerminalEvidence: retain in repository as sanitized source of truth
evidenceRetention.workflowArtifacts: 14 days unless a later policy explicitly extends it
evidenceRetention.operationalSummaries: retain sanitized rolling evidence; never store tokens, passwords, raw bank/government IDs or secret payloads
evidenceRetention.incidentEvidence: retain sanitized evidence through incident closure and successor-release certification

classification.reusableCXOrbia: permanent read-only monitoring, severity, incident, patch, evidence-retention and periodic recovery policy
classification.exclusiveClient: TyA production release identifiers and operational HR/project specifics
classification.claudePrototype: no UI change; only incident-driven exact-file handoff if needed
